published_evidence.exploitation_evidence: The target contract cannot be called, which makes the cross-chain message function unable to work properly.
published_evidence.fix_strategy_evidence: Modify the message field as specified by the user.
published_evidence.root_cause_evidence: The user's message field is overwritten with an empty string.

    30 |      */
    31 |     function send(ZetaInterfaces.SendInput calldata input) external override whenNotPaused {
    32 |         bool success = IERC20(zetaToken).transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), input.zetaValueAndGas);

    41 |             input.destinationGasLimit,
    42 |             input.message,
    43 |             input.zetaParams
    44 |         );
    45 |     }

    48 |      * @dev Handler to receive data from other chain.
